claims.statement: From 31 July 2026, covered manufacturers must repair within reasonable time and price, provide repair information and make spare parts available at reasonable prices; an EU repair platform is planned.
Repairers gain visibility and consumers gain comparison tools, but whether Polish repair networks will pay for parts sourcing and SLA prediction is unknown.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Repair-network operations head, manufacturer service director or independent repair shop owner
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Cross-brand parts availability and predicted repair completion; manufacturers and distributors control supply and can bundle
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business for repair-shop accounts while consumer ownership depends on channel terms
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Repair associations, parts distributors and the future public repair-platform ecosystem

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Assumption: 300-1,500 PLN per repair shop through distributor channels
fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Monthly subscription and transaction fee after completed order
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 55-75% after payment, support and data costs
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Catalog normalization, dispute handling and supplier onboarding
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Consumer law, payments, insurance and marketplace terms
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Payment processing, returns, catalog APIs and support

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Parts distributors expose better APIs; manufacturers direct repair traffic to authorized networks
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: A repair quote or job stalls because a compatible part, price or delivery date cannot be confirmed
commercial_mechanics.payer: Repair shop, service network or parts distributor
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Accepted repair request requiring a part and promised completion time
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Monthly shop subscription and each parts transaction

contrary_evidence: The public European repair platform may solve discovery without a private layer.
Parts data is fragmented and rights holders may refuse access.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: No distribution rights held; proposed nonexclusive supplier data and distribution agreements
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Use public catalogs, onboard alternate distributors or sell shop workflow without transaction inventory
critical_control_point.current_owner: Manufacturers and distributors own parts inventory data and fulfillment; repairers own their customer relationships
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business for repair-shop accounts while consumer ownership depends on channel terms
critical_control_point.duration: unknown; proposed annual supplier and shop terms
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: No present repair-network or parts-data access
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Prospective business after signed supplier and repairer agreements
critical_control_point.subject: Normalized parts-availability and repair-SLA transaction exchange

economics.acquisition_route: Pilot one appliance category with two distributors and 20 shops, initially forwarding orders without holding stock
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 2,000 shops at 300 PLN monthly plus 3m PLN annual transaction margin yields 10.2m PLN revenue; at 18% EBITDA and 4-6x, value can exceed 5m PLN in years 8-11. Supply access and shop density are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 20 hours weekly; catalog and support operations need hiring at scale
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription and commission less payments, returns, data and support
economics.payback: Assumption: 150 shops plus transaction volume recover setup in 24 months
economics.pricing: Assumption: 150-500 PLN monthly per shop plus 3-8% parts-order commission
economics.retention_or_repeat: Frequent repair jobs and growing cross-brand catalog utility

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Cross-brand compatibility graph and observed delivery/SLA history
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Parts intelligence subscription plus transaction commission
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Repairer pays when sourcing a part for an accepted job
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Right-to-repair demand rises but parts discovery and timing remain fragmented

founder_fit: Channel sales reduce need for personal brand.

structure.control_point: Compatibility and availability graph at quote time
structure.critical_dependency: Nonexclusive supplier data and fulfillment agreements

thesis: Future state: repairers can quote covered repairs with reliable part price and timing. The missing transaction mechanism is a cross-brand availability exchange connecting repair jobs to compatible inventory and predicted SLAs.
title: Repair-Parts Availability Exchange
